scripts.setup: node --input-type=module -e 'import { existsSync } from "node:fs"; import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises"; import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process"; import { resolve } from "node:path"; const root = process.cwd(); const configDir = resolve(root, "formatter-common-config"); const configRepoUrl = "https://github.com/wanachh/formatter-common-config.git"; const vscodeDir = resolve(root, ".vscode"); const biomeConfigTarget = resolve(root, "biome.json"); const run = (command, args) => execFileSync(command, args, { cwd: root, stdio: "inherit" }); if (!existsSync(configDir)) { run("git", ["clone", configRepoUrl, "formatter-common-config"]); } else if (existsSync(resolve(configDir, ".git"))) { run("git", ["-C", "formatter-common-config", "pull", "--ff-only"]); } run("npm", ["install"]); const biomeConfigSource = [resolve(configDir, "biome.shared.json"), resolve(configDir, "biome.json")].find((path) => existsSync(path)); if (!biomeConfigSource) throw new Error("Could not find a shared Biome config in formatter-common-config/."); await mkdir(vscodeDir, { recursive: true }); const settings = JSON.stringify({ "editor.formatOnSave": true, "editor.defaultFormatter": "biomejs.biome", "[json]": { "editor.defaultFormatter": "biomejs.biome" }, "[jsonc]": { "editor.defaultFormatter": "biomejs.biome" } }, null, 2) + "\n"; const extensions = JSON.stringify({ recommendations: ["biomejs.biome"] }, null, 2) + "\n"; await writeFile(resolve(vscodeDir, "settings.json"), settings); await writeFile(resolve(vscodeDir, "extensions.json"), extensions); await writeFile(biomeConfigTarget, await readFile(biomeConfigSource)); console.log("✅ VS Code workspace settings created for Biome");'
scripts.update-config: git -C formatter-common-config pull --ff-only && echo '✅ Config อัพเดทแล้ว! อย่าลืม git add . && git commit'
